title: v0.2 roadmap: per-segment + hybrid modes, FluentCRM and Groundhogg adapters
body:
# v0.2 roadmap

v0.1 ships the per-recipient core and the Newsletter (Stefano Lissa) adapter. v0.2 closes out the personalization-mode matrix and adds two more adapters.

## Goal

- Implement **per-segment** mode (one AI call per audience segment, body cached and reused for every recipient in that segment).
- Implement **hybrid** mode (AI inspects the audience + prompt, decides whether to segment or per-recipient, then either runs the per-segment path or falls through to per-recipient).
- Ship **FluentCRM** adapter implementing `PersonalizationProviderInterface`.
- Ship **Groundhogg** adapter implementing `PersonalizationProviderInterface`.

## Files to modify

- `includes/Personalization/SegmentPlanner.php` — **new**. Given an audience and a personalization prompt, asks the AI Client to return a segment plan (segment_id, criteria, sample subscribers, segment-level rewrite). One AI call per campaign.
- `includes/Personalization/Personalizer.php` — branch on `Settings::mode()`:
  - `MODE_PER_SEGMENT` → ask `SegmentPlanner` for the recipient's segment, return its pre-rewritten body.
  - `MODE_HYBRID` → call `SegmentPlanner::should_segment()`; if true, run per-segment; otherwise fall through to per-recipient.
- `includes/Adapters/FluentCRM/FluentCrmAdapter.php` — **new**. Hooks: `fluent_crm/email_body_generated`, `fluentcrm_subject_pre_send` (verify exact filter names against FluentCRM source before relying).
- `includes/Adapters/Groundhogg/GroundhoggAdapter.php` — **new**. Hooks: `groundhogg/email/body`, `groundhogg/email/subject` (verify against Groundhogg source).
- `includes/Core/Plugin.php` — register both new adapters alongside `NewsletterAdapter`.

## Reference pattern

Follow the existing `NewsletterAdapter` shape:
- Implement `PersonalizationProviderInterface` (`id()`, `label()`, `is_active()`, `register()`, `build_placeholders()`).
- Short-circuit `register()` if `is_active()` is false.
- Call `Personalizer::personalize()` with `provider`, `campaign_id`, `subscriber_id`, `kind` (`html`|`text`|`subject`), `body`, `placeholders`.

## Verification

For each new adapter:
1. Install and activate the target newsletter plugin in `wp-env`.
2. Configure an AI connector under `Settings → Connectors`.
3. Enable AI Newsletter under `Settings → AI Newsletter` with mode = per-recipient.
4. Send a test campaign to two recipients with distinct `country` values.
5. Verify the rendered prompts (debug log) include each recipient's data and that the resulting bodies differ.
6. Verify the cache: re-send and confirm zero new AI calls (object-cache hits).

For per-segment / hybrid:
- Audience of 100, three distinct `country` values.
- Per-segment: expect 3 AI calls total (one per segment), all 100 emails sent.
- Hybrid: depending on prompt, AI either picks per-segment (3 calls) or per-recipient (100 calls).

## Out of scope for v0.2

- Cost tracking (explicitly out of scope per product owner).
- WaaS / network-admin surface (this plugin is per-site only).
- Mailster, MailPoet, AcyMailing, Email Subscribers adapters (defer until demand surfaces).

## References

- WP AI Client: https://make.wordpress.org/core/2025/10/abilities-and-ai-client-in-7-0/
- Newsletter plugin filters used in v0.1: `newsletter_message`, `newsletter_message_text`, `newsletter_send_user`, `newsletter_message_headers`, `newsletter_send_skip` (file: `classes/NewsletterEngine.php`).

<!-- aidevops:sig -->
---

title: Supervisor health dashboard stale: 2d0h (#3)
body:
## Premise

The dashboard at #3 last refreshed `2026-05-07T23:03:19Z` — **2d0h ago** (threshold: 2d0h). The `stats-wrapper.sh` scheduler is likely failing silently.

## Why this matters

The supervisor health dashboard is the framework's primary single-glance health surface. When it stops refreshing, operators keep trusting green numbers that no longer reflect reality — every decision derived from "dashboard says green" becomes invalid.

## Triage

1. Inspect the stats scheduler status (macOS):

   ```bash
   launchctl list | grep -i aidevops-stats-wrapper
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist
   ```

2. Run the refresh manually and capture the error:

   ```bash
   bash ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
   ```

3. Check the dashboard issue directly:

   ```bash
   gh api repos/Ultimate-Multisite/superdav-ai-newsletter/issues/3 --jq '{updated_at, body_length: (.body|length)}'
   ```

## Remediation

- **Missing plist:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so `setup_stats_wrapper` reinstalls `com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist`.
- **`set -euo pipefail` fail:** the post-t2418 wrapper emits `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=<N>` on error. Grep `stats.log` on that prefix.
- **Body size / API error:** inspect `stats.log` — look at `gh` HTTP errors and `_update_health_issue_for_repo` failures.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified and documented on this issue.
- [ ] `gh issue view 3 --repo Ultimate-Multisite/superdav-ai-newsletter` shows an update within 24h of closing this alert.
- [ ] `last_refresh:` marker is present in the dashboard body.

<!-- aidevops:generator=dashboard-freshness-check -->
<!-- aidevops:dashboard-freshness:Ultimate-Multisite/superdav-ai-newsletter:3 -->
